lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to prophesy against Pharaoh, who claims the Nile is his and that he made it.
God will haul Pharaoh out of his rivers with hooks, and Egypt was only a staff of cedar to Israel.
God will make Egypt a ruin from Migdol to Syene for forty years and scatter the Egyptians.
After forty years God will gather the Egyptians and bring them to the land of Goshen as a lowly kingdom.
Nebuchadnezzar's army labored against Tyre without wages, so God gives him the land of Egypt as his reward.
